plugins.description: Use when building on Powabase (the AI Backend-as-a-Service). Triggers: knowledge bases, RAG, document indexing/retrieval; agents, tools, ReAct, sessions; multi-agent orchestration; workflows, blocks, webhooks, copilot; the /api/* agentic surface; and the Powabase BaaS layer (PostgREST, GoTrue auth, Storage, Realtime, direct Postgres) on *.p.powabase.ai projects.
